accounting.baseline_limits: Native SPB-tree/AV-tree/HDR+ are not executed. Do not label the own CPU GTS layout or saved-frontier baseline as those implementations. Full native strong-baseline5x performance admission remains NOT_EVALUATED.
accounting.denominators: Report repair only and one independent lifecycle(index+initial query+one delete+repair+complete initial/final output),never mix. Metric-call ratios are work proxies,not CPU/GPU speedups.
accounting.excluded: Input parse,experimental reset/cloning,all-pair reference,posthoc diagnostics and raw audits separately excluded. No wall-time confidence/tail claims on this single fixed-order shared-CPU screen.
accounting.included: Online method CPU work includes ranking,cache/heap handling,tombstone application,affected lookup and complete output materialization. Index and common reverse-posting initialization charged separately. Serialization timed separately and included in reported lifecycle seconds;close without fsync.
accounting.payload: Tombstone membership is physically updated;immutable string storage is not copied or reclaimed. Report container payload/capacities,not RSS or full native update ACK.
accounting.threshold_gap: Integer edit-distance ties can change top-k IDs without raising tau;report separately. No post-hoc continuous jitter or radius retuning.

correction: The parent fixed-radius pivot-cache experiment does not test this threshold-dependent pruning decision. Metric lower bounds may remain valid while a previous cutoff decision ceases to apply.

decision.5x_boundary: No claim of a new algorithm or5x win without an implemented future-blind candidate beating the strongest admitted ordinary method under identical complete lifecycle. Native comparison gaps stay unknown.
decision.INVALID: First input/source/build/quality/resource failure stops;no automatic population retries.
decision.headroom: If not near and online>=5*oracle with online>0 in both target episodes of both datasets,label RESTRICTED_WORK_HEADROOM_ONLY;still no new mechanism or GPU admission. Other valid results are UNCLASSIFIED_STOP.
decision.mechanism: OBSERVED only if some query tau rises and its old cut has a live previously-unscored candidate under old_tau<LB<=new_tau;otherwise NO_EXPANSION_OBSERVED_IN_SCOPE,not a universal rejection.
decision.near_oracle: For each dataset and each TARGET256/DRAIN episode,RETAIN_FRONTIER total repair metric calls<=1.10*fixed-tree threshold-oracle calls(integer10*online<=11*oracle;both0 counts as equal). If all pass,label LOCAL_REPAIR_NEAR_RESTRICTED_ORACLE and STOP_FIXED_TREE_REPAIR_FAMILY.
decision.novelty: NOT_ADMITTED in all outcomes;batch dirty-set de-duplication,retained frontier,and candidate reserves are controls,not proposed contributions.
decision.reopen: A distinct mechanism must beat ordinary repair with charged additional metadata/initialization,or establish evidence under an explicitly different cache/tree/workload contract. Do not revive a stopped family from large stale-node overlap alone.

deletions.DRAIN_OLD_TOPK: Union of all old exact top-k result IDs;at most1360 rows;all old answers removed for every query.
deletions.RANDOM256: Seeded uniform256 reference IDs,without using query distances.
deletions.RANDOM_MATCHED: Seeded uniform deletion of exactly the DRAIN union size. Matched count is fixed from old answers before any repair.
deletions.TARGET256: Round-robin ranks of old exact top-k lists in fixed query order;take first256 distinct IDs;fill by seeded reference permutation only if needed. Uses old answers only,no future distances.
deletions.freeze: Write all four deletion ID lists before first post-update method call. Adversarial synthetic update episodes,not real application traces.

methods.FIXED_TREE_THRESHOLD_ORACLE: Diagnostic copy of RETAIN_FRONTIER initialization;given true post-delete kth distance only after all online methods finish. Expand only min-LB nodes with LB<=true tau and verify candidates. Same immutable tree,saved scores,numerics and strict tie expansion. No oracle input to online methods;not an arbitrary-index or information-theoretic lower bound.
methods.FULL_RANK_CACHE: Ordinary all-query/all-reference score/rank cache. Charge all4096*64 distances and rank storage at initialization;post-delete filtering computes no distances. Diagnostic strong simple control,not a new mechanism.
methods.GTS_CACHED_ROOT_RESTART: Pinned ten-way CPU GTS layout;retain old answers and reverse postings;restart best-first from root only for affected queries. Query-local memoization;seed surviving old scores;no unchanged old scores recomputed if already retained. Not native GTS kNN/update executable.
methods.QUICKJOIN_TOPK_SEEDED: Pinned rectangular range-join helper wrapped as exact top-k:within each k group derive an upper radius from first k live reference IDs per query,charge these seed distances,run Quickjoin at maximum safe group bound,rank all intermediate matches,retain only top-k. Only affected queries after update. Not original Quickjoin executable or a native kNN join.
methods.RESERVE_K32: Same as RETAIN_FRONTIER;initially search k+32,output only k. Charge all initialization work/storage. Terminal episode repairs to k,not k+32.
methods.RETAIN_FRONTIER: Same layout;retain every evaluated query-point score and the min-LB unexpanded-node cut. Delete tombstones,seed from surviving cached scores,resume best-first until min LB>current kth distance. Existing pivot values remain immutable authorities even if deleted.

question: Does deletion-raised exact kth distance reopen previously pruned frontiers,and does ordinary saved-frontier continuation leave substantial repair-distance work relative to a fixed-tree threshold oracle?

scope.episodes: Four independent single atomic-delete episodes reset to the same initialized state. No intermediate ACK/query visibility;ordinary baselines deduplicate affected queries before repair. No inserts,metric changes,concurrency or service-SLA simulation.
scope.join_scope: Fixed64 external queries against4096 changing reference occurrences;not full self-join.
scope.metric: Exact byte-wise Levenshtein;retain duplicate values as distinct source IDs. DNA is GRCh38-derived108bp,not original GTS DNA.
scope.selection: Reuse the independently sampled4096 reference occurrences from the parent certificate experiment. Uniformly sample64 external query occurrences from the original65536-row parent trace,excluding reference IDs and both original query sets. Shuffle query order by the same fixed RNG. No radii or calibration by observed outcomes.
scope.tie_rule: Exactly k rows ordered by(integer edit distance,uint64 source ID). Strict LB>tau pruning;expand equal-bound nodes.
